title: AI Outcomes Manager, Strategic Tech
reason: Works with enterprise customers to design and deploy AI solutions and guide technical adoption.
current_evidence: Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion
description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of strategic accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Outcomes AI Manager for Strategic Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas. You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves. Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business. Responsibilities: Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment. Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions You may be a good fit if you have: 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high-growth and established tech companies. You understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C-suite sponsorship Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet. Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling. A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

These are the engineers who design, build, and run the data pipelines used by the world’s leading AI labs and enterprises. You’ll shape the function’s direction, drive its execution, and manage our fastest-growing team as it scales from 40 to 100+ engineers. You’ll set the technical and organizational strategy that turns one-off implementations into reusable solutions—pipelines, evals, augmentations, and environments—and invest in shared ways of working. In our product lifecycle, FDE sits between Research, which defines novel approaches and training needs, and Engineering, which scales our platform and pipelines from 1 to 100. FDE owns the most important middle stretch, taking every new investment from 0 to 1. Your organization is responsible for both what we deliver and how we deliver it. Just as Engineering is the final gate for what goes to production, FDE is the final gate for every dataset that ships to a customer. Nothing goes out without your team’s sign-off. You’ll also own the pipelines that produce that data, from cost and throughput to latency and efficiency. This role is for a deeply technical leader who is, first and foremost, a doer . You’ll understand pipeline architecture well enough to challenge designs and propose direction, while coaching your managers and tech leads to think beyond their individual projects. In a fast-moving market where resourcing shifts often, you’ll be the steady hand who keeps teams focused on what customers actually need, not just what was specified. Main Responsibilities Lead and scale the FDE organization: set the vision, define the operating model and org design, and align team plans and strategy with company priorities. Drive hiring in hypergrowth: build a strong bench of engineering managers and tech leads, and keep the hiring bar high while the organization scales rapidly. You’ll grow to 100+ engineers in the coming quarters. Coach and develop EMs and TLMs who run pods of FDEs, helping them grow from single-project owners into leaders who see and solve problems across the delivery organization. Drive reuse across the organization: identify patterns across bespoke deliveries, have FDE build the first version, and partner with Platform Engineering to scale them company-wide. Set engineering standards for how the FDE organization works, including pipeline design, data evaluation and verification, delivery sign-off, and root cause analysis, so every team operates to one standard. Establish FDE as the final point of control for delivery quality: define quality bars, own sign-off on every dataset that ships, and make sure every customer requirement is verified. Plan and adjust capacity as priorities shift, rebalancing teams quickly while keeping delivery commitments intact. description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Machine Learning Intern, you join the team to explore framed topics, assess their relevance and feasibility through proofs of concept, and help the strongest ideas reach production. You own your project end to end, from literature review and scoping to implementation and benchmarking, on topics shaped by live projects and production needs. You work in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, on cutting-edge research topics in an emerging defense company where the stakes are high. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship. Responsibilities Run literature reviews and state-of-the-art analyses on computer vision and machine learning topics framed by the team. Scope projects, define tasks, and decide which approaches to benchmark, from baselines to the most prominent algorithms. Build experimentation plans and define implementation architectures for novel approaches. Collect, prepare, synthesize, and augment data for model training and evaluation. Implement, train, and benchmark models across topics such as foundation models, knowledge distillation, CNNs, transformers, and embedded models. Explore multi-sensor fusion and the processing of temporal data where projects call for it. Evaluate results rigorously with task-specific metrics to judge relevance and feasibility. Develop proofs of concept and support the transition of promising ones towards production. Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects. Candidate Requirements Currently pursuing an MSc in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field. Hands-on experience with ML projects involving model training and evaluation, ideally across different tasks and architectures such as CNNs and transformers. Ability to select the best-performing model for a use case and to choose suitable task-specific evaluation metrics. Familiarity with computer vision and image processing is a plus, such as classification, detection, tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, or 3D vision. Awareness of model scale trade-offs, from large multi-GPU architectures to small optimized models on embedded platforms. Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
reason: Works with enterprise customers to design and deploy AI solutions and guide technical adoption.

description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. Et tout commence par vous. Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès. Analyses, business cases & prototypage Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Continuous & Automated Assessment: Develop automated, continuous assessment capabilities that replace manual reviews and scale seamlessly across the business unit. Self-Service Tooling: Partner with developers to build scalable, self-service security tools that empower teams to detect and remediate risks independently. Preventive & Detective Controls: Implement robust preventive and detective controls to deliver ongoing assurance rather than point-in-time security checks. Strategic Collaboration & Incident Response: Drive long-term security strategy with key stakeholders while actively participating in periodic on-call rotations for incident support. AI-Driven Security Innovation: Utilize AI technologies and methodologies to streamline threat detection, accelerate security evaluations, and advance scalable system protection. Profile (Nice to Have) Advocate for security standards with clarity and empathy. Familiarity with AI/ML workflows and agents. description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission. Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it. Key responsibilities Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end. Own the commercial data model. Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it. Own the pricing primitives: the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches. Make the contract the source of truth. Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start. Automate the path from signature to a live customer. Lead the durable workflows that provision a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold, recover from partial failure, and route exceptions to the right person with the context to resolve them. Build for people and agents. Own the interfaces for agreements, entitlements, and pricing terms that seller tools and Claude-powered agents read and write, so both get the same safe, auditable capabilities. Own planning and delivery. Turn competing asks from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and product teams into a clear roadmap, make the trade-offs explicit, and hold the team to its milestones. Operate what you ship. Set SLOs on the flows your team runs, instrument them so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and keep on-call sustainable as volume grows. Minimum qualifications 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering teams including hiring, coaching and performance management. A strong background building production backend systems, with enough depth in a language such as Go, Python, or Java to review designs and code. Experience leading teams that built billing, payments, pricing, contract management, or other financial systems of record in production. Experience modeling transactional or financial data, including relational databases and SQL. Experience leading teams that built and operated asynchronous, long-running workflows, such as on a durable workflow engine like Temporal or on queues and state machines. Preferred qualifications Experience building CPQ, contract management, or quote-to-cash platforms, and firsthand knowledge of how one change to pricing terms ripples through quoting, provisioning, invoicing, and revenue reporting. Experience with enterprise commercial structures such as multi-year or ramped commitments, drawdowns, amendments and renewals, or one agreement shared across many accounts. Experience integrating or extending third-party billing, payment, or CRM platforms, and opinions on where they fall short. Experience building revenue reconciliation or financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to pass a financial audit. Experience automating a high-touch operational process and measuring the manual work it removed. Experience building LLM-powered tools or agents, or systems designed for agents to call safely.
